mission: Build ONE dossier in the published v2 format. Read docs/enrichment/dossiers/HANDOFF.md, README.md and DISAMBIGUATION.md first, then docs/enrichment/EXEMPLARS.md and docs/enrichment/HUMANIZER-SKILL.md.
standard: The Self (docs/enrichment/dossiers/the-self.md) and Anger (anger.md) are the exemplars: exhaustive map (every wiki card on the theme, grouped by subtheme), real divergences with verbatim-checked quotes from opened carriers, Variation-Selection(+Retention) practice section, Nearby terms section per DISAMBIGUATION.md.
deliverables: docs/enrichment/sources/dossiers/<slug>.md (evidence ledger, every quote verified word-for-word against an opened carrier)
registry status flip to published is SUPERVISOR-ONLY: leave status 'planned' and flag in a commit message
the Academy data splice is SUPERVISOR-ONLY: do NOT edit site/assets/app.js or style.css; never edit progress.json or the queues
verification: Every card link verified against actual content/ filenames by script before pushing. No hallucination: every fact and quote from a source actually opened (owner library: docs/PRIMARY-SOURCES.md). Humanised per HUMANIZER-SKILL.md.
push: scripts/enrich_save.sh "<message>" (verifies 'saved and verified on origin/main'); fallback scripts/api_push.py. Save after every item and every ~10 minutes.
baton: python3 scripts/baton.py clock-in <band> <agent-name>; clock in at every milestone; release when the band's list is exhausted.
source_queue: owner-directed mint 2026-10-25 (in-session owner message): four new dossiers (frustration, creation, creativity, procrastination); registry docs/enrichment/dossiers/registry.json
note: Owner-directed mint 2026-10-25 (in-session owner message, worker-pplx-1025-1530): mint recorded for supervisor review like the Hypo-egoic intake precedent. Follow DISAMBIGUATION.md for nearby terms; the Creation/Creativity boundary is owner-given (Creation = meaning-in-life theme; Creativity = the capacity). Title and full-text sweep terms: see registry scope. Artwork assignment is pending supervisor selection from the owner's collection.
pre_push_check: python3 scripts/dossier_check.py docs/enrichment/dossiers/<slug>.md (exit 0 required before pushing)
full_text_sweep: rg -il '<term>' content/ | sort  — run per family term after the title sweep to catch stragglers (cards whose body treats the term without it being in the title); verify substance by reading the card
title_sweep_starting_inventory: Not pre-computed: run your own title sweep (ls content/concepts content/kernels content/stories | rg -i '<family terms>') then the full-text sweep below.
